AGREEMENT FOR ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT, RESTRICTIVECOVENANTSANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISAGREEMENTFORZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT,RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement") is made as of_M aX 3, 2011, by and between HD DEVELOPMENT OF MARYLAND, INC. c/o HOME DEPOT U.S.A., INC., a Maryland corporation, whose mailing address is C.20 -- Real Estate Law, 2455 Paces Ferry Road, Atlanta, Georgia 30339 (*Home Depot"), and FAE HOLDINGS WOODSIDE LLC, a New York limited liability company, whose mailing address is c/o Storage Deluxe,26 West 17th Street, Suite 801,NewYork,New York 10011 ("Storage Deluxe"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, by virtue of a conveyance from Home Depot by Bargain and Sale Deed with Covenants Against Grantor's Acts of even date herewith, Storage Deluxe is the owner of that certain tract of land described on Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof, said property being referred to herein as the “Storage Deluxe Property"; and WHEREAS,HomeDepot is the owner of that certain tract of land shown onExhibit B attached hereto and made a part hereof, said property being contiguous to the Storage Deluxe Property, and being hereinafter referred to as the “Home Depot Property” (the Storage Deluxe Property and the Home Depot Property being referred to collectively as the “Properties,” and each a “Property"; and the owners of each being referred to collectively as the “Owners", and each an “Owner", or individually, the “Storage Deluxe Property Owner” and the “Home Depot Property Owner"); and WHEREAS, Home Depot desires to impose certain restrictions on the Storage Deluxe Property for the benefit of the Home Depot Property; and WHEREAS, Storage Deluxe desires to impose certain restrictions on the Home Depot Property for the benefit of the Storage Deluxe Property; and benefit of the Storage Deluxe Property and Storage Deluxe has agreed to grant Home Depot certain easements for the benefit of the Home Depot Property; and WHEREAS, the creation, use and maintenance of the easements and restrictions granted herein will be beneficial to the Properties.

NOW,THEREFORE,for andinconsiderationofTen andNo/100Dollars($10.00)and other good and valuable consideration in hand paid by each party hereto to the other (including, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto, intending to be legally bound, do hereby agree as follows: ARTICLEI-- GRANT OF EASEMENT Section 1.01. Utility Easements. (a) HomeDepotUtilityEasements.TheStorage DeluxeProperty Owner,as grantor, hereby grants and conveys to the Home Depot Property Owner, as grantee, for the benefit of the Home Depot Property and for the use of the Home Depot Property Owner and its officers, directors, employees, agents, contractors, invitees, licensees, assignees, and subtenants (Permittees") a non-exclusive, perpetual easement, right and privilege appurtenant to and running with title to the Home Depot Property over and under and across that portion of the Storage Deluxe Property in the locations shown onExhibit C-1 (the “HD Utility Easement Areas"), for the installation, operation, flow, passage, use, connection, repair, access, location, maintenance, replacement and removal of the existing eight inch (8") fire service main related to the Home Depot Property as shown on Exhibit C-1. (b) The Home Depot Property Owner shall comply with all reasonable guidelines and/or restrictions that the Storage Deluxe Owner may impose upon the Home Depot without limitation,those relating to the adequacy of soil compaction, thebedding of any piping, and restoration of the ground surface.All work performed by the Home DepotProperty Owner within the HD Utility Easement Areas shall comply with applicable codes and building practices and shall not interfere with any existing utility lines serving the Storage Deluxe Property. The Home Depot Property Owner shall remove all debris, equipment and other property placed within the HD Utility Easement Areas by or for the Home Depot Property Owner, shall fill and level all ditches,ruts and depressions caused by such operations to the satisfaction of theStorage Deluxe Property Owner. The Home Depot Property Owner shall also repair and restore the surface of the HD Utility Easement Areas to as near its original condition as possible, all within a reasonable time following completion of the work at its sole cost and expense and to the repair any damage to theStorage DeluxeProperty resultingfrom the use of theHDUtility Easement Areas by the Home Depot Property Owner, including, without limitation, any damage caused by any excavation on the Storage Deluxe Property. In the exercise of the rights granted permanently detrimental to the Storage Deluxe Property. Except in an emergency, the Home Depot Property Owner shall provide the Storage Deluxe Property Owner at least ten (10) days prior notice of any work to be performed within the HD Utility Easement Areas.
